summary: Read-only audit of draft #64 proposed rules, not deployed rules. Owner isolation, matching create/update validation and deny-by-default paths are sound; Storage MIME metadata does not verify raster content. No Firestore/Storage integration is enabled by Sprint 7.

findings.issue: An authenticated owner can upload arbitrary bytes with an allowed image MIME label. Rules validate metadata only.
findings.recommendation: Before adding image consumption, decode and re-encode with bounded trusted processing; keep objects private and do not treat MIME labels as proof of safe content.

findings.issue: Ownership requires authentication but not verified email. This is valid for private self-data; it cannot establish a verified sharing identity.
findings.recommendation: Define a verified-email requirement before adding public sharing or privileged operations; do not infer it from uid ownership.
